paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi ahon mangbangsak ua." Israelte'n chi uhen.
heading: Israelte Melmate Dou Dia Thumna
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi hon mangbangsak ua; himahleh hon zou tuan kei uh.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

paite: Lei lette'n ka nungzang ah lei alet ua; aleileh kuangte uh asausak uhi."
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

paite: TOUPA adiktat ahi; migilou-saloute khauhualte a- attanta, chi in.
english: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

paite: Amau zahlak leh taizaksak in om uhen, Zion hote tengteng mah.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

paite: Inn tung a loupa akhansang ma a vuai bang in om uhen.
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

paite: Huai loupa in buh atmi khut ahihdim nhei kei a, bumphali telkhawmimin leng a-angsung ahihdim ngei sam kei hi.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

paite: Na tung uah TOUPA vualzawlna om hen; TOUPA min in ka hon vualzawl uhi, apaikhen mite'n achi sam kei uhi.
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
